title: VacationResponse::new takes impl Into<Id> inconsistently
description: VacationResponse::new(id: impl Into<Id>, ...) is the only constructor in the crate that accepts impl Into<Id> for the id field. All other constructors (Email::new, Mailbox::new, Thread::new, etc.) take Id directly. This creates an inconsistent ergonomic pattern — code that works for VacationResponse won't work for Email without .into(). Pick one convention and apply it everywhere. Since Id::from is cheap, preferring impl Into<Id> uniformly is more ergonomic.
